extraction_notes: Main-text performance data digitised from Figure 2 only. Figure 2 inset was skipped because it is an Arrhenius plot. Figure 3a–c show mass-spectrometry intensities/ratios rather than NH3 synthesis rate, outlet NH3 concentration or TOF; Figure 3d is N2 isotope exchange, not NH3 synthesis; Figure 3e is NH3 formation under pure H2 from lattice nitrogen; Figure 3f is TPR; Figure 4 is DFT, so these were skipped. In Figure 2a, bars for catalysts other than Ni/LaN NPs and Ni/LaN bulk are not resolvable from the origin on the published axis and were digitised as approximately zero.
